messages.body_plain:
Hi,
I'm more or less new in statistics.
I'm writing because I have some problem with my data.
I have to run an ezanova by subject and one by Item.
So, for the first one no problem.

summaryBysj = summaryBy(mean~Sj+group+grouptrans, data = allgr_key, , FUN=c(mean))

an = ezANOVA(
  data = summaryBysj
  , dv = .(mean.mean)
  , wid = .(Sj)
  , within = .(grouptrans)
  , between = .(group)
)
an

For the item analysis:

 byItem = summaryBy(mean~Word+group+grouptrans, data = allgr_key, , FUN=c(mean))

anByI = ezANOVA(
  data = byItem
  , dv = .(mean.mean)
  , wid = .(Word)
  , within = .(grouptrans)
  , between =.(group)

  )

I riceve this message: Errore in ezANOVA_main(data = data, dv = dv, wid = wid, within = within,  :

I try to run ezdesign: you find the result in the attached file.
It seems that there are not missing data.
so What's the problem?

Thanks
